Text-first presentation compiler with behavioral markup.


View as Interactive Presentation:
https://fnndsc.github.io/slidedown/readme-presentation/


Documentation: docs/
Examples: examples/
What is slidedown?
Do you like text? Have you ever wished that text was the
basic substrate for compelling slideshows that are self
contained and run in a browser?


slidedown is a LaTeX-inspired markup language for creating
interactive HTML presentations from plain text.

Text-first authoring - write presentations like you write code
Behavioral markup - .directive\{content\} syntax
Interactive effects - typewriter animations, progressive reveals
Single-file workflow - one .sd source → standalone HTML
Themes
Five built-in themes — each presentation below uses the same
source compiled with a different theme:


conventional-light → https://fnndsc.github.io/slidedown/themes/conventional-light/
default → https://fnndsc.github.io/slidedown/themes/default/
lcars-lower-decks → https://fnndsc.github.io/slidedown/themes/lcars-lower-decks/
retro-terminal → https://fnndsc.github.io/slidedown/themes/retro-terminal/
terminal → https://fnndsc.github.io/slidedown/themes/terminal/


Select with --theme at compile time.
Runtime switching is not supported — each theme is a full compile.
Quick Start 






# Clone and set up
git clone https://github.com/FNNDSC/slidedown
cd slidedown
make dev

# Compile and serve a presentation
make presentation SOURCE=examples/minimal/minimal.sd

# Open http://localhost:8000
    







No make? Use the slideshow script directly:





./slideshow examples/minimal/minimal.sd --theme conventional-light
    


   







    Directive Syntax




    
    
  
       The core syntax is simple:





.directive{content}
.directive{\.modifier{value} content}
.directive{nested \.directives{work} too}
    







Structure:     
.slide{} - defines a slide
     
.title{} - slide title (metadata)
     
.body{} - slide content





Formatting:     
.bf{} - bold
     
.em{} - italic
     
.tt{} - monospace
     
.code{} - code block





Effects:     
.typewriter{} - typing animation
     
.o{} - progressive reveal bullets
   







    Installation




    
    
  
       Recommended — via Makefile:





git clone https://github.com/FNNDSC/slidedown
cd slidedown
make dev
    







Manual install:





python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install -e ".[dev]"
    







Requirements:     
Python 3.11+
     
pip or uv
     
Modern web browser





Platforms: Linux, macOS, Windows (WSL), Android (Termux)   







    Usage




    
    
  
       Via Makefile:





make presentation SOURCE=examples/minimal/minimal.sd
make presentation SOURCE=examples/minimal/minimal.sd THEME=retro-terminal PORT=9000
make compile SOURCE=examples/minimal/minimal.sd
make serve SOURCE=examples/minimal/minimal.sd
    







Via slideshow script:





./slideshow path/to/deck.sd --theme lcars-lower-decks
./slideshow path/to/deck.sd --no-serve --outputdir /tmp/out
    







Direct CLI:





slidedown inputdir/ outputdir/ --inputFile deck.sd --theme terminal

Here's a minimal example:





.slide{
  \.title{My First Slide}
  \.body{
    \.typewriter{> Initializing presentation...}

    \.bf{Features:}
    \.o{\.em{Text-first} authoring}
    \.o{\.tt{Behavioral} markup}
    \.o{Interactive \.bf{effects}}
  }
}
    


   







    Project Structure




    
    
  
       
slidedown/
├── src/
│   ├── __main__.py          # CLI entry point
│   ├── lib/
│   │   ├── parser.py        # .sd syntax parser
│   │   ├── lexer.py         # Tokenizer
│   │   ├── compiler.py      # AST → HTML compiler
│   │   ├── compiler_rendering.py
│   │   ├── compiler_assets.py
│   │   ├── directives.py    # Directive implementations
│   │   ├── theme.py         # Theme loader
│   │   └── theme_base.py    # Theme hook system
│   └── models/              # Type definitions
├── themes/                  # 5 built-in themes
├── assets/                  # CSS, JS, HTML templates
├── docs/                    # Documentation + hosted presentations
├── examples/                # Example .sd decks
└── tests/                   # 97 tests
    


   







    Testing




    
    
  
       Run all tests:     
make test
    







Individual test files:     
pytest tests/test_parser_basic.py -v
pytest tests/test_e2e_compilation.py -v
    







Coverage report:     
make coverage
    







97 tests across 5 test files:     
test_parser_basic — directive parsing
     
test_parser_modifiers — .style{} and .class{} extraction
     
test_parser_nesting — recursive structure
     
test_parser_escaping — escape sequences
     
test_e2e_compilation — full pipeline integration
   







    Architecture




    
    
  
       Functional Pipeline Pattern:





.sd source → Parser → AST → Compiler → HTML
               ↓         ↓        ↓
          ProgramState → → → → → →
    







Key Concepts:     
State Bus - ProgramState dataclass carries state
     
Inside-Out Compilation - children compiled first
     
Placeholder Substitution - markers for child content
     
Theme Hook System - themes subclass ThemeHooks for custom layouts
     
Directive Registry - extensible handler system
   







    LCARS Theme




    
    
  
       The lcars-lower-decks theme brings a Star Trek LCARS
     interface to your presentations.





Dynamic scaling (v1.2.0):     
[ / ] — scale topbar up/down (100→75→50→25%)
     
\{} / \ — scale gutters up/down
     
TB / GW on-screen buttons for touch/mouse
     
Scale state persists across reloads via localStorage





Toggle chrome:     
HIDEDETAIL / SHOWDETAIL collapses the full topbar
     
Smooth CSS transition animations





Live demo:
     https://fnndsc.github.io/slidedown/themes/lcars-lower-decks/
